task: Vendor claim workflow for inbound discrepancies. Automatically log quantity shortages/damages during inbound processing and link them to the PO for vendor claims.
checklist: System calculates expected vs. received quantities per PO line
Discrepancy automatically generates a Claim Record linked to the PO
Vendor metric counters (/requested, /fill-list) are updated in real time
Negative: quantities match -> no claim is created
Edge: partial shipment across multiple pallets -> discrepancy is aggregated per PO, not per pallet
Edge: damaged item vs. missing item -> classified with different claim reason codes
Duplicate scan of the same unit does not double-count the discrepancy
Audit: claim creation includes PO id, expected qty, received qty, and operator
